entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... yes. I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes a while back and... I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know if I can. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly look into that for you. So I can pull up your account, could you provide me with your order number?
An order number... um, one second. Okay, I think it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. I see the order right here. Before we go further, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. The problem is they just hurt. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but every time I ride, the cycling shoes give me terrible blisters on my heels. I just can't use them.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the purchase date here... I see you received them 68 days ago.
Sixty-eight days? Oh no, is that too long? The policy page was so complicated. I just want to know if I can get a refund. I feel so helpless with this stuff.
No need to worry. Let me check the policy for you. (pause) Okay, I have good news. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much. So, what do I need to do?

I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. Simply pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be issued.
Okay, I can do that. A label in my email. Thank you, David, you've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Have a wonderful day.
